From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Subject: Vendor onboarding: banking rails & invoice field mapping (Edgemont Labs)

Hi Sara —

Thanks for choosing Redwood for payouts. To get Edgemont fully live on our payment rails we need the following so FinOps can verify and activate ACH/wire: 

- Completed W-9 or equivalent tax form (PDF)
- Bank confirmation letter on bank letterhead (shows account name + last 4 digits)
- Preferred payout method: ACH or wire? If both, please indicate one as primary
- ACH details: routing number, account number, account type (checking/savings)
- Wire instructions: bank SWIFT/BIC + intermediary if required
- Remittance string requirements: which invoice field must contain the PO/Order ID (e.g., "OrderRef"), and any invoice labels we should preserve
- Sample invoice/remit CSV (3 rows) so we can validate automated reconciliation mapping

Goal: turn on micro-deposits and confirm remittance mapping by EOD next Wednesday (2026-12-02). If you can attach the bank letter and W-9 in reply that will speed things up.

Thanks — appreciate it.

Ben Carter
Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0134

Attachments: none in this message
